active_family: 308 learned center path plus residual shell
current_bottleneck: The learned deterministic center path is the useful structural piece. The remaining failure is specifically the stochastic law: a diagonal coarse shell around a deterministic center makes conditional spread come from independent residual noise, which broadens intervals but erases shared cross-cell and pathwise residual structure.
last_result_summary: Stage-A isolation confirmed the mechanism. The learned 289c-style center alone scored 3/11 and preserved cross-cell geometry (corr ratio 0.596, rank ratio 1.356), while 308a dropped to 2/11 because the shell improved coverage but collapsed correlation structure (corr ratio 0.032, rank ratio 4.343). The 308 family is therefore still alive only if Stage B is replaced, not tuned.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 309a: keep the learned deterministic center path, but replace the coarse shell with a vanilla joint residual path flow-matching model conditioned on history and center. Model residual transitions jointly across all future times and cells; do not add new shell knobs or low-rank side structure.
